The HTTP source plugin has the following requirements and constraints:
• The path option is required. The path is a string such as /log/ingest, which represents the URI
path for log ingestion. This path deﬁnes the URI that you use to send data to the pipeline. For
example, https://log-pipeline.us-west-2.osis.amazonaws.com/log/ingest. The
path must start with a slash (/), and can contain the special characters '-', '_', '.', and '/', as well as
the ${pipelineName} placeholder.
• The following HTTP source options are set by OpenSearch Ingestion and aren't supported in
pipeline conﬁgurations:
• port
• ssl
• ssl_key_file
• ssl_certificate_file
• aws_region
